offering_description.value: Manufactures specialty materials including advanced interlayers, performance films, cellulose-based fibers and plastics, additives and chemical intermediates. Sells to industrial manufacturers in transportation, building, consumer goods and packaging. Produced at large integrated chemical plants, increasingly with molecular recycling.

primary_products.value: specialty copolyester plastics; acetate tow and textile fibers; window and paint protection films; polyvinyl butyral interlayers; coatings additives and chemical intermediates

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive, building, packaging, consumer goods, personal care, coatings and tobacco product manufacturers

end_markets.value: transportation; building and construction; consumer goods; packaging; personal care and food; tobacco

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty materials, chemicals and fibers sold to industrial customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts propane, ethylene, paraxylene and wood pulp into specialty materials sold to manufacturers; raw materials: supplies chemical intermediates and additives to downstream formulators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and Middle East, with major plants in US, Netherlands and China

specialization.value: related lines: advanced materials, additives and functional products, chemical intermediates, and fibers sharing technology platforms

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to large industrial manufacturers and converters; distributors / dealers: chemical distributors and film installer networks

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical manufacturing subject to EPA, REACH, OSHA, TSCA and emissions and safety rules
